thesis: The podcast argues that highly valued private technology companies now represent approximately $5 trillion in market cap, which is nearly a quarter of the S&P 500. It further discusses the trend of companies staying private longer, noting that while 88% of market cap creation for top tech firms occurred after going public ten years ago, 55% of recent IPOs happened while companies were still private.
